```{r}
library(dplyr)

data <- read.table("/Users/sorenbasnet/Desktop/STAT_443_SP_2026/guide_dataset/datafiles/fat.dat")

data <- data %>% 
  select(-c(V1, V3, V4, V8, V9))

```


```{r}
m1 <- lm(V2 ~ ., data=data)
summary(m1)
plot(m1)



plot(data$V2, m1$fitted.values)
#abline(coef(m1))

```
